entries.law: Gambling can win over every character in the game EXCEPT Starlette and the Singers. She is exempt by construction, not by a flag.
entries.why: Mark, 2026-09-02. Starlette is exempt because she is not in monsterWrappers at all, so no isSinger predicate exists or should be invented — a flag would be a second source of truth for something the data model already answers.

entries.law: Every player-facing EVENT LOG line and every monster or NPC dialogue line is a bilingual haiku, English with Japanese. THE GUIDEBOOK IS EXEMPT.
entries.why: Mark, 2026-09-03: 'every conversation = has to be haiku', and in the same turn 'but spare the guidebook - its my world'. The exemption is his, is explicit, and is not an oversight to be tidied away by a later pass.

entries.law: NEVER sanitize the Japanese or goblin humour, and never pitch decluttering the busy Japanese UI — the density is intentional.
entries.why: Two of Mark's standing laws, kept together because both are refusals aimed at the same instinct: an outside eye reads the game's voice and its dense animating UI as noise to be tidied, and tidying either one removes what the game IS.

entries.law: Actions have results even when they are not apparent at first glance: the karma system holds the player responsible for their own choices, and it must never reward psychotic killing.
entries.why: Mark, 2026-08-08, verbatim: the system 'actually seems to encourage psychotic killing behavior when that was not its original intent'. The plan is three-phase and every number in it is a proposal until falsified.

entries.law: THE MUSIC NEVER STOPS. Tracks cross-fade over 2500ms with zero gap; silence is never a destination.
entries.why: Mark's RULE #1 of 2026-08-20. It supersedes the older fade chain that lived only in comments, and a missing destination — a state with no track assigned — reads to the player as the music breaking.

entries.law: NON-VIOLENCE IS THE SPINE. A wager or an ally beats a kill. Never add kill-quests, and never re-tune the toll.
entries.why: The karma system was measured to encourage the exact behaviour it was built to discourage, and Mark's correction made the peaceful route the strong one rather than the polite one.

entries.law: THE DUNGEON SLEEPS AT START. Waking is EARNED, and aggro is acoustic — noise wakes the floor, proximity alone does not.
entries.why: Mark's RULE #1 of 2026-08-01. The sleeping floor is what makes a quiet approach a real choice; a dungeon awake at spawn deletes the entire stealth register of the game.

entries.law: A new value in an old field makes every old consumer of that field a suspect. When you widen a data model, enumerate its readers before shipping, and grade the RENDERED outcome, not the data.
entries.why: S5 gave floor 1 segment ids for the first time; an old streaming pass then hid 49/83 seam walls and 179 objects at spawn. The data was correct, every gate was green, and the floor was unplayable by sight.

entries.law: Any pass that hides geometry must state what happens to its collider, in the same breath.
entries.why: Colliders stayed while walls hid — the suppress-without-replace invisible-barrier family, third occurrence in the casebook.

entries.law: Prefer the fix that reuses the machinery's own reverse path over a new sweep beside it: gate the DECISION, not the function entry.
entries.why: Forcing visible=true drove the pass's own restore arm, so fix and unwind are one line and no second sweep can drift out of step with it.

entries.law: A truncated pipe is not a measurement. Capture full output to a file, and never quote a number you cannot point to in a RECEIVED result — a reconstruction from source is a hypothesis wearing a measurement's clothes.
entries.why: A probe piped through `tail -45` lost its header; the missing line was remembered from the probe's SOURCE and reported as measured. Two trap boots chased a phantom the probe never printed.

entries.law: An instrument must enter the PLAYER'S state (guide dismissed, T&C accepted) before it claims to see what the player sees — and visual evidence is graded separately from numeric evidence.
entries.why: A verify probe's generic button-sweep did not dismiss the welcome modal; its screenshots shipped masked while its numbers were fine. Fifth harness-state artifact of the season.

entries.law: Every zero needs a control that must NOT be zero. A count that cannot move is not evidence.
entries.why: V1 acceptance: parking OFF read 0 suppressed and forcing it ON read 230. One arm alone proves nothing. Reaffirms the 08-31 silence-signature law live.

entries.law: When a fix lands near a symptom, prove the connection or record the separation. Never let one landing silently absorb a neighbouring mystery.
entries.why: V2's 40 hidden lights: stamped-by-this-pass read 0/0 in BOTH arms, so a different writer owns them and the hunt stayed open rather than being closed by adjacency.

entries.law: A check that never runs is not a check that passed. Run your gates ON HEAD before trusting them to judge a change — red-on-arrival is its own finding.
entries.why: smoke:segments was dead at init (runtime:false, gates:0) since roughly 2026-08-04, binding nothing while looking like coverage. Its floor-1 assertion had been vacuously true its whole life.

entries.law: A gate edited by the change it judges stops being evidence. Repair it in its own task, in its own commit.
entries.why: SEG-GATE was split out rather than folded into the commit it would grade; a seat refused the combined option on exactly these grounds.

entries.law: Report not-applicable as null, never as 0, and make the assertion skip loudly. A vacuous green is the most expensive colour in this repo.
entries.why: staticLeaks scoping returns {applies:false, leaks:null} with a stated reason, and its selftest carries a forced-true control proving the skip is scoping rather than the rule quietly dying.

entries.law: A fallback that ALWAYS fires is not a fallback — it is the value. When a term is renamed across an engine generation, hunt every read of the OLD name; the ones with defaults are the ones nothing will ever flag.
entries.why: window.DUNGEON_LEVEL is Engine8 vocabulary and never existed at runtime, yet two live reads consulted it, each with a `: 1` fallback — so both silently computed floor 1 forever.

entries.law: One published fact per concept, born beside the fact it describes so the ordering is provable by construction. Fossil reads retire with a SUPERSEDED marker; module-private names keep their names.
entries.why: The engine now publishes window._currentFloor beside the seed rather than leaving each consumer to re-derive a floor from Engine8 vocabulary.

entries.law: Refute a live defect honestly AND arm the guard for the documented future — write the why at the site the future editor will actually be looking at.
entries.why: RoomPermits' per-floor guard is redundant today (descent reloads the iframe, so a leak is impossible by construction) but Engine9's boot-then-re-applies-state path names the future where it is the only net.

entries.law: Delegate, falsify, adjudicate: seats hand diffs and measured numbers with caveats, and the lead reproduces the numbers with its OWN run before staging. A refusal on principle is a deliverable.
entries.why: Seats refused to present a red gate as green, to back-fill an unmeasured arm, and to claim un-booted results; naming a risk BEFORE the boot is what stops a symptom patch from rewriting a contract.

entries.law: Grep every reference of every file you touched, then READ each match before writing it: bump references, never prose. The bump and its content land in ONE commit.
entries.why: The first outing under seat-owned tokens caught the stranded Panels.html?mode=dock&v= trap (five bumps, not four) and a near-miss where a PlayerGuide.js line matches the token pattern but is prose inside a comment.

entries.law: Print the whole object as JSON and let a LATER line do the summarising, so the raw record survives even when the verdict logic is wrong. Never let the summary be the only artifact.
entries.why: Three seats destroyed evidence at the moment of writing it down, in one day: a whole audit object fetched and only `.ok` logged; headers lost to `tail` twice; a truncated line remembered from source. Distinct from a false zero — here the measurement SUCCEEDED and the part that mattered was deleted at the print boundary.

entries.law: A probe reads and writes PUBLISHED handles only. A forced call must prove it RAN via a side-effect read-back, and a zero from an unreachable symbol is not a measurement — it is the harness describing its own blindness. Reachability is per SYMBOL, not per file.
entries.why: Four instances in one day: window.DUNGEON_LEVEL never existed; a probe's window.px created a do-nothing property while the real pose lived in a module let, so it teleported the monster and measured a player who never moved; an injected typeof-check was simply false and its line measured nothing; and ~90 local `const px` declarations shadow the published pose.

entries.law: An enumeration in a comment is a CLAIM — verify it like one before relying on it, and when you extend the group, extend the list in the same diff. A confident under-count is more dangerous than silence.
entries.why: Section0's own 'FOUR WRITERS MOVE TOGETHER' note omitted a fifth, the room's RESIDENT, and the eviction took him. A reader who checked all four named items would conclude the migration complete BECAUSE the list looked exhaustive.

entries.law: Before retiring a wrong value, enumerate what its wrongness currently HOLDS UP: grep the symbol's consumers, then ask what behaviour depends on the VALUE. Never grade a fix by the size of its diff when it can flip an existence invariant.
entries.why: The Ogre's hardcoded segmentId 0 was wrong — his room is section 4 — and was also the only reason he EXISTED on a floor-1 boot, since section 4 spawns last and the permit chain needs a resident. Correcting the tag to the truthful 4 deleted him and made the GUARD POST PERMIT unobtainable: strictly worse than the eviction it fixed. The engine said so out loud, two log lines from one boot contradicting each other, because a prior seat wired the UNOBTAINABLE warning. Loud contradictions are a gift; wire more of them.
